properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 5 at 11:59AM UTC until July 5 at 12:30PM UTC by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
SMWGUM

THE NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE IN TIYAN HAS ISSUED A

* SPECIAL MARINE WARNING FOR...
GUAM COASTAL WATERS...

* UNTIL 1230 PM UTC.

* AT 1159 AM UTC, A SERIES OF THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING
WATERSPOUTS WERE LOCATED ACROSS GUAM COASTAL WATERS, MOVING SOUTH
AT 60 KNOTS.

HAZARD...WATERSPOUTS AND WIND GUSTS IN EXCESS OF 50 KNOTS.

SOURCE...RADAR INDICATED.

IMPACT...WATERSPOUTS CAN EASILY OVERTURN BOATS AND CREATE LOCALLY
HAZARDOUS SEAS. BOATS COULD SUFFER SIGNIFICANT STRUCTURAL
DAMAGE IN HIGH WINDS. SMALL CRAFT COULD CAPSIZE IN
SUDDENLY HIGHER WAVES.

* LOCATIONS IMPACTED INCLUDE...
SOUTHERN GUAM COASTAL WATERS.
properties.instruction:
BOATERS SHOULD SEEK SAFE HARBOR IMMEDIATELY UNTIL THIS STORM PASSES.
WIND GUSTS 34 KNOTS OR GREATER, HIGH WAVES, DANGEROUS LIGHTNING, AND
HEAVY RAIN ARE POSSIBLE WITH THIS STORM.

REPORT SEVERE WEATHER TO THE COAST GUARD OR NEAREST LAW ENFORCEMENT
AGENCY. THEY WILL RELAY YOUR REPORT TO THE NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE
OFFICE.

properties.description:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Charlotte Harbor and Pine Island Sound...
Coastal waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood FL out 20 NM...
Coastal waters from Englewood to Tarpon Springs FL out 20 NM...
Waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood FL out 20 to 60 NM...
Waters from Englewood to Tarpon Springs FL out 20 to 60 NM...

waterspouts was located near Don Pedro Island, moving northeast at
25 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats, damage
vessels, and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots,
suddenly higher waves, frequent lightning, and heavy
downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

Englewood, Venice Inlet, M4 Reef, Siesta Key, M17 Reef, Big
Sarasota Pass, M5 Reef, Md4 Reef, Sarasota Bay Hart Reef,
Gasparilla Island, Md3 Reef, M6 Reef, M15 Reef, M9 Reef, Manasota
Key, Sanibel, Venice, Lynn Silvertooth Reef, Fort Myers Beach, and
M10 Reef.
properties.instruction:

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.
